HashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF sources and the exact Pester It command AST extent without a trailing newline.
Validation: PowerShell 7 and Pester 5.7.1 on Windows. Isolated fixtures exercise the publication and child-failure boundaries with local temporary files. Real build, release contents, fleet installation, and CUDA hardware qualification remain separate.

Selectors.Selector: routes <Case> to exit <ExitCode> with the expected release writers
Selectors.Protects: Only successful builds with a passing requested-test verdict publish outputs. Prior output retirement precedes preflight, and caught publication errors retire partial output. Standalone modes preserve their existing behavior.
Selectors.Detects: Release writer calls after failure, preflight before output retirement, lost diagnostics, or exit zero for missing or empty failure data.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and TestDrive. Extracted top-level statements run in an owned child with inert build and release stubs.
Selectors.Breadcrumb: Build.ps1 main execution, post-build tests and release output calls.
Selectors.ReviewScope: Exact top-level statements validated release and diagnostic gating, preflight failure, publication error recovery, successful deploy order, and standalone isolation.

Selectors.Selector: returns no artifacts when the inference child <Case>
Selectors.Protects: Failed inference invocations retain the log path and do not advertise cached target artifacts.
Selectors.Detects: Cargo target lookup or artifact copying after a child returns nonzero or throws.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and TestDrive with an inert child script.
Selectors.ReviewScope: An inert child exits 17 or throws a specific error. The fixture asserts failure, no artifact lookup, the expected error on throw, and a log for the nonzero exit.

Selectors.Protects: Explicit CUDA requests require a complete discovered toolkit before the inference build starts.
Selectors.Detects: A missing helper or toolkit falling through to CPU mode.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and a disposable stub discovery helper. No CUDA or compiler.
Selectors.ReviewScope: Both missing-input cases fail with the documented message. The fixture uses the exact parsed production CUDA branch.

Selectors.Selector: does not require CUDA when the switch is absent
Selectors.Protects: CPU-only builds do not require the CUDA toolkit or discovery helper.
Selectors.Detects: Applying the toolkit guard to CPU-only requests.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5 and a nonexistent helper path in TestDrive.
Selectors.ReviewScope: The unchanged CPU-only control passes without a helper; no compiler is run.

Selectors.Selector: archives only the last publication for the requested mode and variant
Selectors.Protects: Previously published manifest, packages, and deploy directory are kept recoverable outside current publication paths.
Selectors.Detects: A stale standard output, byte changes, duplicate empty archives, or moving another variant or unrelated files.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5, and owned temporary filesystem paths. Use a fixture version and no publisher.
Selectors.ReviewScope: The real archive helper moves only the expected paths and preserves sampled contents while leaving older versions, CUDA output, and unrelated cached files alone.

Selectors.Selector: returns no FunctionGemma artifacts when the training child <Case>
Selectors.Protects: FunctionGemma needs both component builds to succeed before staging any artifact.
Selectors.Detects: A cached executable or DLL copied after a build failure or swallowed child exception.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5, and a temporary cache with inert compiler and artifact resolver stubs.
Selectors.Breadcrumb: Build.ps1 Invoke-FunctionGemmaBuild child loop and artifact collection.
Selectors.ReviewScope: A successful first crate followed by false or a thrown error must call no resolver and create no staging directory.

Selectors.Selector: refuses an output root reached through a linked parent
Selectors.Protects: Build output retirement cannot traverse a linked parent directory.
Selectors.Detects: A move through a Windows junction or Linux symlink before verifying managed output roots.
Selectors.Needs: PowerShell 7, Pester 5, TestDrive, and local filesystem link support.
Selectors.ReviewScope: The fixture links a parent outside the named build path, verifies early refusal, and verifies untouched destination and archive paths.

Selectors.Selector: probes the effective CUDA declaration for <Case>
Selectors.Protects: Each backend validates its effective CUDA declaration, including a numeric legacy GGML override when shell defaults request unsupported targets.
Selectors.Detects: An unrelated default rejecting a valid backend, a missing effective declaration, or a combined backend build checking only one target list.
Selectors.Needs: Pester 5, the actual extracted CUDA branch, inert directories and a synthetic nvcc code list.
Selectors.ReviewScope: Baseline daff6198 failed four of six cases. The revised branch and real toolkit selector use each effective declaration without invoking nvcc or a real CUDA install.

Selectors.Selector: rejects an architecture suffix in legacy GGML input <Target>
Selectors.Protects: Legacy GGML receives numeric architecture targets only.
Selectors.Detects: A suffixed target, including a dotted target, reaching the compiler and later being discarded.
Selectors.Needs: Pester 5, the extracted production CUDA branch, a stub that throws if invoked.
Selectors.ReviewScope: Both compact and dotted suffix spellings fail before a compiler probe.

Selectors.Selector: preserves the GGML override and compiler after optional CUDA library setup
Selectors.Protects: The child receives the admitted GGML target and CUDA toolkit after optional library setup.
Selectors.Detects: Dropping the target export or picking another compiler whose path was prepended during library setup.
Selectors.Needs: Pester 5, TestDrive, the extracted production CUDA branch and actual path helper with inert discovery and library stubs.
Selectors.ReviewScope: The fixture verifies override admission and export, promotes the selected CUDA path after a library prepends its own path, and retains that library path.
